_doc: Named standard RL configurations of InteriorGS v10 (round 12, the user's handover for the experiment matrix): training_prep rl-config --standard NAME, or plan rl.standard in the training chain. Each fixes the options of the recipe; the start model, the rows (reserve train tasks, sft-frames --include-reserve), the depth-check exclusion, the run folders and the seed stay with the run. Every RL experiment is a pair: the S0 and the D configuration of one recipe, same start, tasks, seed and number of updates (decision 2026-10-19, round 12). Template paths are relative to data_gen/interiorgs_v10/.
_v10_p1: The optimisation package of round 11 (P-S0 / P-D, interiorgs_v10_train_r11p_20261017): GRPO without a value network, only tasks whose 8 episodes both succeed and fail, 24 candidate tasks per update of which 12 are the nominal batch (dropped tasks refilled from the other 12), lr 2e-6, KL coefficient 0.05, entropy bonus 0.01, one sequence per episode, reserve train tasks, a checkpoint every 50 updates, no validation inside training. Seed of round 11: data.seed 20260930 (the template), rollout seed 0.
_v10_p2: Round 12 candidate standard: p1 with 48 candidate tasks per update, so that the 12 trained tasks are filled (p1 kept about 6).
_dense_batch1: The dense reward's first batch (the user's decision of 2026-10-21): p1 with the keep_by_return_std group filter: places the mixed tasks leave free go to all-fail tasks whose 8 returns spread (std, n-1) at least keep_std_threshold, their group comparison dividing by at least keep_std_floor. Thresholds from pair 1's training rollouts (cluster_runs/KEEP_THRESHOLD_R12_20261021.md): the top 20% of the all-fail spreads, 0.335 under D, 0.134 under S0. Floor 1.77 = 5/sqrt(8), the smallest spread a mixed task can have; 1.0 the variant with a stronger signal.
_chain_defaults: Round 12 freeze (the user's decision 3 of 2026-10-22): the chain settings of the standard. The training chain applies chain_defaults to every run whose plan rl names a standard, for each setting the plan does not give (the plan's values win, key by key inside guards and startup): 32 render workers per render service (renderer_workers), the render service submitted before its trainer (renderer_first), a render service held while its trainer waits moved off a machine left to such services (renderer_repack), the stop rules of the round-12 batch with the 10% unreadable-answer line (guards; the A group sets kl_max 1.0 in its plan), 5 start-up retries (startup) counted apart from the plan's retries (plan startup_retries_separate).
_dcond: D-cond (the user's decision of 2026-10-22, docs/dense_reward_dcond.md): the dense reward with the grouped, gated progress (0.25 frame + 0.25 face + 0.5 relation, the relation group only once the target is in frame; reward preset D_cond). v10_p1_Dcond keeps the package's mixed-outcome filter; D-cond + keep (keep_by_return_std, floor 1.0) takes its threshold from the D_cond returns of all-fail tasks (the top 20% of their spreads), given as plan rl keep_std_threshold until it is fixed here.
_turn_footprint: Experiment 3A (the user's decision 甲 of 2026-11-06): the p1 pair with in-place turns blocked by the robot-base footprint (env turn_footprint_radius 0.25 m: object boxes reaching into 0.1-1.0 m, and walls); everything else as v10_p1_S0 / v10_p1_Dcond. V4 = v10_p1_Dcond_fp + plan rl progress_reward_scale 3.3333333333333335, group_filter keep_by_return_std, keep_std_threshold 0.3318, keep_std_floor 1.0 (configs/matrix_r12.json rl.dense).
_v10_p1gae: The main line's PPO supplement (the user's decision 甲 of 2026-11-08): the p1 pair with GAE and a value network instead of GRPO (package p1gae: the template's critic from the RL start model, lr 2e-5 constant, fp32, parameters and optimizer offloaded, cliprange_value 0.5; the template's gamma 0.95 / lam 0.95, as the round-11 R-S0 PPO; critic_warmup 11, so the value network trains alone for the first 10 updates and endpoint 310 gives 300 actor updates); everything else as v10_p1_S0 / v10_p1_Dcond. V4 = v10_p1gae_Dcond + plan rl progress_reward_scale 3.3333333333333335, group_filter keep_by_return_std, keep_std_threshold 0.3318, keep_std_floor 1.0. The plan gives no rl critic_warmup (rl-config refuses one other than the package's).
